sections: This Privacy Policy explains how Weather V processes personal data on Android and iOS, what categories are collected, for which purposes and legal bases, with whom data is shared, how long it is retained, and how to exercise privacy rights under GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, VCDPA, and LGPD.
Controller: Metamodern Dev, LLC; privacy contact for all jurisdictions: metamodern.dev@gmail.com; no Data Protection Officer is appointed at this time.

This Policy applies to the Weather V mobile application by Metamodern Dev, LLC, covering all its versions regardless of the name under which it is distributed in app stores. It governs personal data processed through the app, related support communications, and the integrated Google services/SDKs used for functionality, diagnostics, consent, fraud prevention, analytics, and advertising where applicable.
We do not operate our own application servers for this product, and data visible to us is hosted within Google’s developer platforms or the device OS according to their terms.

items: Device or other IDs: device and advertising identifiers (e.g., AAID or App Set ID) used for analytics, app integrity, attribution, and AdMob ad delivery where applicable, consistent with Play Data safety taxonomy.
App interactions: limited in‑app event telemetry supporting functionality quality, measurement, and product improvement in accordance with platform rules.
Crash logs: diagnostics directly related to crashes for reliability and troubleshooting in line with platform disclosure guidance.

sections: We do not collect sensitive categories for purposes beyond providing app functionality and we do not sell personal information.

list.title: We use third-party services to provide and improve the App. These services may access your data as described in their respective privacy policies. We encourage you to review their policies to understand how they handle your data.
items:
Google LLC — Google Mobile Ads SDK (AdMob): ad delivery and measurement, including use of device/advertising identifiers and consent signals where required.
– How Google uses information from sites or apps that use our services

Google LLC — Google Analytics for Firebase: app measurement and product improvement in accordance with platform policies and disclosure requirements.
– Privacy and Security in Firebase
– Google Analytics for Firebase Terms

Google LLC — Firebase Crashlytics: crash diagnostics and stability data surfaced in developer consoles.
– Firebase Crashlytics & Firebase App Distribution Terms of Service

Google LLC — Google Play services (including Integrity/App Set ID): security, integrity checks, and limited identifiers to protect users and the service.
– Google Privacy Policy
– Google Play Terms of Service

Google LLC — Google UMP (Consent): consent collection for EEA/UK and other regions where required by law or platform rules.
– Google's EU User Consent Policy

Google LLC — Google Play Console/Android Vitals: aggregated stability/quality metrics available to developers via dashboards.
– Google Play Developer Distribution Agreement

OpenWeather Ltd — OpenWeather API: weather data retrieval to support app functionality; requests are issued from the device to the weather service.
– OpenWeather Privacy Policy

sections: We may rely on Google’s downstream ad and CDN partners for delivery under Google’s platform terms, and these partners are governed by Google’s disclosures and opt‑out mechanisms.

items: Provide and operate the app: performance of a contract and legitimate interests to deliver core features and ensure availability, with consent where required by local law or platform rules.
Diagnostics, security, and fraud prevention: legitimate interests and legal obligation, including integrity checks necessary to protect the service and individuals.
Analytics and product improvement: legitimate interests or consent where required for measurement and experience quality via Firebase Analytics.
Advertising and attribution: consent where required or legitimate interests with opt‑out rights under applicable consumer privacy laws; all ad serving is via Google AdMob.
Compliance and requests handling: legal obligation and legitimate interests to meet statutory duties and respond to data rights requests.

sections: The app may use AAID or App Set ID for analytics, integrity, attribution, and ad delivery where applicable, and OS‑level reset/opt‑out controls apply in addition to any in‑app controls.

Only permissions necessary for features are requested with in‑context rationale; declining an optional permission limits only the related feature and does not result in discrimination for exercising privacy rights.

Android permissions requested include AdServices identifiers/attribution/topics, network state, billing, install referrer, license check, foreground service, internet, and wake lock as needed for functionality and disclosures.
We do not maintain application servers for this product; data is stored and processed by Google’s services acting as processors or independent providers under their platform roles and safeguards.

Cross‑border transfers rely on Google’s contractual and technical safeguards permitted by applicable laws. These safeguards include, but are not limited to, adequacy decisions by relevant authorities and the use of Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) as approved by the European Commission, ensuring an adequate level of data protection. We apply data minimization for all processing.

We do not sell personal information and do not share personal information for cross‑context behavioral advertising as defined by the CCPA/CPRA, and Global Privacy Control signals are honored where applicable.
For Virginia residents, opt‑out of targeted advertising and sale of personal data is supported; ad delivery is performed exclusively via Google AdMob subject to consent where required.

We retain personal data only as long as needed for the purposes described and then rely on provider deletion/aggregation windows, with most developer‑visible analytics and stability data available for up to 90 days in provider consoles.
We do not extract, replicate, or extend retention beyond provider windows, and no application data is stored on our own servers.

Individuals have rights to information, access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, and objection, plus safeguards against automated decision‑making and the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.
Submit requests to metamodern.dev@gmail.com; responses are provided within one month and may be extended as permitted by law with notice.

Rights include know/access (categories and specific pieces, sources, purposes, recipient categories for the past 12 months), deletion subject to statutory exceptions, correction, opt‑out of sale/share, limit use of sensitive data, and non‑discrimination.
Requests may be submitted via metamodern.dev@gmail.com or in‑app controls; verification and statutory timelines apply, and recognized GPC signals are honored where applicable.

Rights include confirm and access, correction, deletion, portability, and opt‑out of targeted advertising and sale of personal data, with an appeal process for denied requests to be decided typically within 60 days.
Requests and appeals can be submitted to metamodern.dev@gmail.com within the timelines permitted by law.
Rights include confirmation and access, correction, anonymization/blocking/deletion of excessive data, portability, information about sharing, and revocation of consent as provided by LGPD.
Requests are answered within LGPD periods and may require reasonable verification of identity to protect individuals.

Send a verifiable request to metamodern.dev@gmail.com stating the request type and jurisdiction; we authenticate requests and respond within the timelines above, free of charge within statutory limits and frequency caps.
If a request cannot be fulfilled due to legal obligations or exceptions, a reasoned response will be provided including appeal steps where applicable.

In‑app controls allow configuring AdMob data processing (personalized vs non‑personalized ads, consent status, and opt‑out of sale/share/targeted advertising); changes take effect immediately for subsequent ad requests.
We honor Global Privacy Control (GPC) signals as an opt‑out of sale or sharing under California law where recognized.

list.title: In addition to in-app controls, you can manage your privacy preferences at the operating system level. You can limit ad tracking or reset your advertising identifier through your device settings:
items: On iOS: Navigate to Settings > Privacy & Security > Tracking.
On Android: Navigate to Settings > Google > Ads > Delete advertising ID. (The exact path may vary by device manufacturer and Android version).

sections: We apply appropriate technical and organizational measures, including encryption in transit and access controls, and require comparable safeguards from Google as our processor or platform provider.

Our services are intended for a general audience, and we have specified a target age of 18 years and older in the app store. We do not knowingly collect, use, or share personal information from children as defined by applicable law (for example, under the age of 13 in the United States or under the age of 16 in the European Union, unless a Member State provides for a lower age).
While the application may receive a content rating suitable for younger audiences, it is not directed at children, and we do not design our services to appeal to them.

If we become aware that we have inadvertently collected personal information from a child without verifiable parental consent, we will take steps to delete that information from our systems promptly. If you are a parent or guardian and believe that your child has provided us with personal information, please contact us at metamodern.dev@gmail.com, and we will take the necessary steps to remove that information.

2025‑10‑14: Initial consolidated edition mapping to Play Data safety categories (Device IDs, App interactions, Crash logs, Calendar events), explicit Google services disclosure (AdMob, Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Play services/Integrity, UMP, Play Console), OpenWeather API, provider‑window retention (generally 90 days), GPC support, and jurisdictional rights/opt‑out sections.
Controller and privacy contact: Metamodern Dev, LLC — metamodern.dev@gmail.com for all privacy inquiries and rights requests worldwide.
